sources.sourceSummaryZhTw: 固定快照用於 #584～#613 的 Open GL／UL／ML 物種排名與 speciesId 對應；季節型四季鹿／萌芽鹿及性別外觀輕飄飄／胖嘟嘟在 PvPoke 僅有 generic speciesId，因此明確標為共享、不可冒充 exact form 排名。

boundary: PvPoke battle presence is never Pokémon GO release evidence. Seasonal Deerling/Sawsbuck and male/female Frillish/Jellicent retain exact Pokémon GO identities, but pinned PvPoke collapses them into shared generic battle identities; shared ranks therefore must not be described as exact form ranks. Shadow IDs are recorded only when the pinned gamemaster contains the concrete speciesId; no `_shadow` ID is synthesized from naming convention.
